## Books {-}

Buffalo, V. (2015). *Bioinformatics Data Skills: Reproducible and Robust
Research with Open Source Tools*. O'Reilly Media, Sebastopol, CA. Example
files: <https://github.com/vsbuffalo/bds-files>

Chacon, S., and B. Straub (2014). *Pro Git*, 2nd edition. Apress, New York.
Free online: <https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2>

Haddock, S. H. D., and C. W. Dunn (2011). *Practical Computing for
Biologists*. Sinauer Associates, Sunderland, MA.
